title: 水輪發電機製造
summary: 以多極磁路、氣隙偏心與垂直軸承串連 12 個技術單元；新增 24 步，包含原理、假想算例、量測設計、失效辨識與驗收證據。
summaryEn: Twelve technical units connect multipolar magnetics, air-gap eccentricity and vertical bearings through 24 new tasks with principles, hypothetical calculations, measurement design, failure discrimination and acceptance evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線工程教育與報告判讀。數值為自行設定的教學假設，非產品保證、現場整定、製造配方或帶電操作程序；高壓、旋轉與大型設備實務由合格團隊依正式規格驗證。完成課程不是專業執照。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education and report interpretation from public principles. Inputs are independently chosen teaching assumptions, not product guarantees, field settings, recipes or live-work procedures. Qualified teams validate high-voltage, rotating and large equipment under formal requirements. Course completion is not professional licensure.

stages.title: 水力與額定
stages.description: 以三個技術單元完成「水力與額定」的模型及判讀，共六項獨立保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Three technical units develop hydraulics and rating through six separately saved modeling and interpretation tasks.

steps.title: 水頭與功率：模型與設計
steps.titleEn: Head and power: model and design
steps.objective: 針對「水頭與功率」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for head and power.
steps.instruction: 先觀看師傅示意，標出「水頭與功率」的輸入、輸出及量測基準，再在學徒工作台排列對應元件或資料流。水力輸入由有效水頭及流量共同決定。 在離線草圖或試算表建立基準與擾動兩種情境，寫出因果預測；用「區分淨水頭與地形高差。」規劃如何反駁模型。把未知參數、單位與邊界記錄在學習筆記。
steps.instructionEn: Watch the mentor diagram, identify inputs, outputs and references for head and power, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Effective head and flow jointly determine hydraulic input. Build baseline and perturbed cases offline and predict causality. Plan a falsification using: Distinguish net head from elevation difference. Record unknown parameters, units and boundaries in your learning notes.
steps.observation: 區分淨水頭與地形高差。
steps.observationEn: Distinguish net head from elevation difference.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「水頭與功率」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping head and power verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「水頭與功率」的兩情境模型、單位表及可反駁預測；說明「區分淨水頭與地形高差。」如何區分情境。
steps.checkEn: Submit a two-case model, units and a falsifiable prediction for head and power; explain how the proposed check distinguishes cases.

knowledge.title: 本單元機制
knowledge.text: 水力輸入由有效水頭及流量共同決定。
knowledge.textEn: Effective head and flow jointly determine hydraulic input.

knowledge.title: 可區分原因的證據
knowledge.text: 區分淨水頭與地形高差。 必須保留基準、單位及不確定度，未有實測資料時只做假想案例判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Distinguish net head from elevation difference. Retain references, units and uncertainty; without measured data, interpret hypothetical cases only.

knowledge.title: 本課量化連結
knowledge.text: 假設 60 Hz、40 極，n=180 rpm；水頭 50 m、流量 100 m³/s、整體效率 0.90，P=ρgQHη≈44.145 MW（ρ=1000 kg/m³，g=9.81 m/s²）。未含水頭隨流量變動。
knowledge.textEn: For 60 Hz and 40 poles, n=180 rpm. With head 50 m, flow 100 m³/s and overall efficiency 0.90, P=ρgQHη≈44.145 MW using ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s²; flow-dependent head is omitted.

quiz.question: 審查「水頭與功率」時，哪個判斷或驗證方法成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which claim or check is justified for head and power?
options: 水力輸入由有效水頭及流量共同決定。
只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「水頭與功率」的驗證。
只調整「水頭與功率」的顯示結果吻合，便可當作獨立量測證據。
optionsEn: Effective head and flow jointly determine hydraulic input.
Equal nominal ratings justify skipping head and power verification.
Tuning the displayed head and power result to match counts as independent measurement evidence.
quiz.explanation: 水力輸入由有效水頭及流量共同決定。 區分淨水頭與地形高差。
quiz.explanationEn: Effective head and flow jointly determine hydraulic input. Distinguish net head from elevation difference.

steps.title: 水頭與功率：量測與判讀
steps.titleEn: Head and power: measurement and diagnosis
steps.objective: 針對「水頭與功率」建立可重算、可檢查的工程紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a reproducible, reviewable engineering record for head and power.
steps.instruction: 先重播本單元模型，讀取兩種假想情境而不接觸真實帶電設備。區分淨水頭與地形高差。 比較差異是否符合「水力輸入由有效水頭及流量共同決定。」；列出至少兩個競爭原因，指定能區分原因的新增量測。先依專案規格訂接受條件，再納入量測不確定度，將未驗證項保持為未決。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit model and inspect two hypothetical cases without accessing energized equipment. Distinguish net head from elevation difference. Compare the result against: Effective head and flow jointly determine hydraulic input. List at least two competing causes and select an additional discriminating measurement. Define acceptance from project requirements before observing results, include uncertainty and retain unverified items as unresolved.
steps.observation: 區分淨水頭與地形高差。
steps.observationEn: Distinguish net head from elevation difference.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：只要名義額定值相同，就可略過「水頭與功率」的驗證。 應先核對量測基準、模型邊界及競爭失效原因。
steps.failureEn: Common mistake: Equal nominal ratings justify skipping head and power verification. Check references, model boundaries and competing failure causes first.
steps.check: 提交「水頭與功率」的量測比較、誤差來源及放行／保留理由；不能用單一平均值掩蓋最差條件。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement comparison, error sources and accept/hold rationale for head and power; do not hide limiting conditions behind one average.
